root_cause: Vanilla Calendar Pro's inputMode adds a keydown listener on the date input that calls preventDefault() on Tab, blocking focus movement to the next form field. Disabling inputMode breaks calendar display on click.
repair_strategy: Keep inputMode enabled for calendar functionality, but add a capture-phase keydown listener on the input that stops propagation of the Tab key before VCP's listener can block it.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key moves focus from the departure date field to the passengers field while preserving calendar display on click and date selection.
functional_risks: Capture-phase listener must be added before VCP's listener attaches (order in _initCalendar ensures this)
Other keyboard navigation inside the calendar (arrow keys, Enter, Escape) should remain unaffected as they are handled by VCP on the calendar element, not the input
verification_requirements: Pressing Tab on the departure date field moves focus to the passengers field
Clicking the departure date field still opens the datepicker calendar
Selecting a date in the calendar updates the input and closes the calendar
Pressing Escape closes the calendar and returns focus to the departure date field
Tab navigation works correctly when the calendar is closed
